scripts.setup: npm install && cd frontend && npm install
scripts.setup:all: npm run setup && npm run setup:backend
scripts.graph:reset: docker compose -f docker-compose.neo4j.yml down -v && npm run graph:up
scripts.dev:fresh: npm run graph:reset && npm run dev
scripts.backend: cd backend && uv run python run.py
scripts.verify:gemini: cd backend && uv run python scripts/verify_gemini_vertex.py
scripts.verify:ollama: cd backend && uv run python scripts/verify_ollama.py
scripts.verify:keiro: cd backend && uv run python scripts/verify_keiro.py
